tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active Agent Ops Jobs listings. Featured roles are listed first among the matches. Each result includes a featured boolean. Does not include closed roles.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch one active listing by its slug, the id used in /jobs/<slug>/.

tools.name: get_posting_info
tools.description: Price, what a post includes, the manual review, and the exact steps to purchase a listing. No arguments.

tools.name: submit_job_post
tools.description: Submit a fractional, part-time, contract, or freelance role. Returns a submission id and the $149 Stripe payment link. featured true also returns featured_addon ($99 USD for 30 days) and does not change that link. Does not publish the role and does not charge a card. Jay reviews it before it goes li

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_posting_info · Public sink: get_posting_info, submit_job_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_posting_info · Public sink: get_posting_info, submit_job_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
